# Santra

> Santra is an offline-first file conversion and editing desktop application for Windows x64 and Linux x64. Files are processed locally, without conversion uploads or accounts. The current release is a development preview.

The website contains an illustrative tool catalogue and a limited browser playground. Desktop tool availability depends on the selected file, validation, and any required detected local engine. Website animations do not execute desktop tools.

Spreadsheet conversion and tools are bundled in the desktop app through a local SheetJS worker; LibreOffice is not required. Supported inputs are XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, and TSV. Conversion outputs are XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV, and layout-limited PDF. Tools include Split worksheets and Delete metadata. Multi-sheet conversion writes separate outputs per worksheet. Formulas are not recalculated. Rewriting may lose unsupported parts, macros, charts, links, and formatting; metadata deletion is not a forensic scrubber. One workbook is accepted per operation, with a 32 MB input limit and a 256-sheet limit.

Raster image processing, subtitle conversion, and archive routes are bundled. Video and audio routes depend on compatible local FFmpeg support; document conversion depends on verified Pandoc routes. JPEG metadata editing additionally requires ExifTool. The repository's capability documentation is the source for current support; some website catalogue descriptions lag behind the desktop app.

## Website

- [Home](https://santra.singhaman.me/): Product overview and limited browser playground.
- [Tools](https://santra.singhaman.me/tools): Illustrative catalogue of file families, operations, and limitations.
- [Use cases](https://santra.singhaman.me/usecase): Everyday workflows.
- [Install](https://santra.singhaman.me/install): Windows and Linux package choices.
- [Pricing](https://santra.singhaman.me/pricing): Current development preview pricing.

## Practical guides

- [Guides](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides): Practical local file workflows with examples, steps, and limitations.
- [XLSX to CSV](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/xlsx-to-csv-offline): Export every worksheet without uploading the workbook.
- [Split Excel worksheets](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/split-excel-worksheets): Separate selected tabs into local files.
- [WebP to PNG](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/webp-to-png-offline): Convert raster images locally.
- [Remove photo metadata](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/remove-photo-metadata): Rewrite an image with supported metadata removed and understand the limits.
- [Trim video](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/trim-video-offline): Save a useful clip with compatible local FFmpeg support.
- [Markdown to DOCX](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/markdown-to-docx-offline): Hand off an editable document using a verified Pandoc route.
- [SRT to VTT](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/srt-to-vtt-offline): Convert subtitles with cue timing validation.
- [Extract ZIP safely](https://santra.singhaman.me/guides/extract-zip-safely): Understand bounded local extraction and unsafe-entry checks.
